Прикметники і прислівники, прислівники ч: Adjectives and adverbs; adverbs of frequency
Коли quick, а коли quickly; чому good, а: When to use quick and when quickly; why good but well; what’s special about hard, fast and late. Plus where always, usually, often, sometimes and never go.
Прикметник описує іменник: який?: An adjective describes a noun: what kind?
Прислівник описує дієслово: як?: An adverb describes a verb: how?
Після be, look, feel, sound, taste, smel: After be, look, feel, sound, taste, smell: an adjective
Прислівник перед прикметником: really, v: An adverb before an adjective: really, very, terribly
прислівник = прикметник + -ly: quick → q: adverb = adjective + -ly: quick → quickly, slow → slowly, careful → carefully
good → well. hard, fast, late, early одн: good → well. hard, fast, late, early are the same in both roles. fastly doesn’t exist.
always, usually, often, sometimes, rarel: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, hardly ever, never: before the main verb, but after be and after an auxiliary (can, have, don’t)
good це прикметник (a good singer), well: good is an adjective (a good singer), well is an adverb (she sings well). After be, look, taste and similar verbs we use an adjective: The cake looks good.
hard і hardly, late і lately: hard and hardly, late and lately
hard = старанно, важко; hardly = ледве,: hard = with a lot of effort, difficult; hardly = almost not. late = not on time; lately = recently. hardly and lately are not the -ly forms of hard and late: they have different meanings.
Прислівник частоти стоїть перед основним: An adverb of frequency goes before the main verb, not between the verb and its object. With am / is / are it goes after the verb. never is already negative, so don’t isn’t needed.
Таблиця: прикметник, прислівник, значенн: Table: adjective, adverb, meaning and note. Frequency scale: always → usually → often → sometimes → rarely / hardly ever → never.

The adverb from easy: y → i + ly, easily. easyly doesn’t exist.

Раунд 4. Частота: де стоять always і nev: Round 4. Frequency: where always and never go
Прислівник частоти перед основним дієсло: An adverb of frequency before the main verb: always walk.
Після be прислівник частоти стоїть за ді: With be, the adverb of frequency goes after the verb: is always.
often перед основним дієсловом. Між дієс: often goes before the main verb. We don’t put it between the verb and its object.
A vegetarian doesn’t eat meat: never.
Once a year is rare: rarely.
Після допоміжного have і перед основним: After the auxiliary have and before the main verb: have never seen.
У питанні прислівник після підмета, пере: In a question the adverb goes after the subject, before the main verb: Do you usually have.
Прислівник перед дієсловом, а дієслово з: The adverb goes before the verb, and the verb takes -s because Lily is she.
